resources.string: The app is free and open source, and a star on GitHub helps other people find it. Right after an update, or after you've used it for a while, a banner above the sessions asks once. Tap it to open GitHub, then close it with its X and it won't come back. You can also find Star on GitHub here and in Settings → About.
A banner above the sessions invites you to star the app on GitHub; tapping it opens GitHub and the banner says thanks until you close it with its X.
